description: This file contains utility functions for handling datasource samples in the Superset project, including limit clause calculation, column name replacement, and sample data retrieval with access control and error handling.

methods.name: get_limit_clause
methods.description: Calculates row offset and limit for pagination based on page number and per_page, with a maximum limit from app config.

methods.name: replace_verbose_with_column
methods.description: Replaces filter 'col' values matching column verbose names with actual column names, operating in-place.

methods.name: get_samples
methods.description: Retrieves sample data from a datasource with pagination, optional payload, access control enforcement, and error handling.
